summary: Inventiva S.A., a French clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firm, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing three abstract presentations at AASLD The Liver Meeting 2026, held November 5-9, 2026, in Denver. The abstracts cover preclinical and Phase 2b data on lanifibranor's balanced pan-PPAR mechanism in MASH, including cfDNA epigenetic findings; topline Phase 3 NATiV3 results are expected in Q4 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are stated. This is a routine scientific-disclosure filing, not a special situation; watch NATiV3 topline as the key catalyst.
